mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story (name, core_idea, initial_stage_direction, status, default_target_characters, writing_style, target_chapter_count) VALUES (#{name}, #{coreIdea}, #{initialStageDirection}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), #{defaultTargetCharacters}, #{writingStyle}, #{targetChapterCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, core_idea, initial_stage_direction, status, default_target_characters, writing_style, target_chapter_count, created_at, updated_at FROM story WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, core_idea, initial_stage_direction, status, default_target_characters, writing_style, target_chapter_count, created_at, updated_at FROM story ORDER BY created_at DESC
